scenarios.name: Open ribbon customization from the Tools tab in its first captured state

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
ribbon customization has not been opened earlier in the captured session
the user clicks "Customize" in the Options panel
the customization dialog opens on the "Ribbon" tab
the Part | Tools custom panel list is empty beneath the "Large", "Text" and "Name" columns
the dialog closes and the Tools ribbon remains visible
